items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: Also I saw an advertisement, friend of mine, Huddie Ledbetter better known as Leadbelly

ctx.x: I see. Let's who else -- Was it Byas?

Yes, Don Byas was at a place called the Rinkside and Bill Coleman was around, too. Also I saw an advertisement, friend of mine, Huddie Ledbetter better known as Leadbelly and he was making an appearance at the University of Paris. And I went to the concert, well received, beautiful man, old man but he's still sharp. He's got a good voice and he was singing while he was there.
Did Paris audiences like the kind of blues singing that he did and his folk songs.
